features.title: Game Features
features.intro: Learn how each faction receives tasks, how ghost tasks work, and who can see the live total-task progress.
features.hero.tip: The three factions use different task pools, refill rules, and progress calculations.
features.tasks.title: Task System
features.tasks.intro: Each faction has a different task structure. Your faction determines the contents of your task list, how completed tasks are replaced, and whether they advance the total-task bar.
features.tasks.good.title: Goose Tasks
features.tasks.good.active: A living Goose always keeps four active personal tasks in their task list.
features.tasks.good.complete: If the required weighted task amount was completed while alive, no ghost tasks are assigned after death.
features.tasks.good.ghost: If the weighted requirement was not met, up to four ghost tasks are assigned after death to cover the missing amount.
features.tasks.good.progress: Tasks completed by Goose ghosts still advance the total-task progress bar.
features.tasks.evil.title: Duck Tasks
features.tasks.evil.sabotage: The task list contains every sabotage task available on the current map.
features.tasks.evil.fake: It also always keeps two fake tasks, refilling back to two after one is completed.
features.tasks.evil.progress: Tasks completed by Ducks never advance the total-task progress bar.
features.tasks.evil.ghost: Duck ghosts may still complete sabotage tasks to gain sabotage abilities and help their living teammates.
features.tasks.neutral.title: Neutral Tasks
features.tasks.neutral.count: Neutral players receive only six fake tasks for the entire match.
features.tasks.neutral.refill: Completed fake tasks are not replenished.
features.tasks.neutral.progress: Tasks completed by Neutrals never advance the total-task progress bar.
features.progress.title: Total-Task Progress Bar
features.progress.good: The total-task bar does not update live for living Goose players.
features.progress.observers: Dead players, Ducks, and Neutrals can see the live progress.
features.progress.moments: When any Moment begins, such as Pelican Moment or Falcon Moment, the Goose faction can also see the live progress bar.
features.note.title: Task Rule Reminder
features.note.body: Task contents vary by map and faction. Only eligible Goose tasks count toward total-task progress.
gameplay.title: How to Play
gameplay.eyebrow: A FRIENDLY START · HOW TO PLAY
gameplay.intro: Each player receives a hidden role. Observe routes, exchange information, and pursue your faction or role-specific victory condition.
gameplay.hero.tip: Confirm your faction goal before reading your ability, and avoid revealing critical roles too freely during meetings.
gameplay.factions.title: Different factions, different ways to win
gameplay.good.title: Goose Faction
gameplay.good.body: Finish all tasks, or identify and remove threats while surviving. Share reliable information, but stay alert for impostors.
gameplay.evil.title: Duck Faction
gameplay.evil.body: Use kills, sabotages, disguises, and misleading meetings to reduce the other factions. Coordinate without leaving decisive evidence.
gameplay.neutral.title: Neutral Faction
gameplay.neutral.body: Neutral roles have independent goals such as being voted out, consuming bodies, infecting players, or becoming the last survivor.
gameplay.guide.title: Follow the flow of a complete match
gameplay.guide.desc: Expand each card for the key decisions and useful habits at every stage.
gameplay.flow.title: 01 · Match Flow
gameplay.flow.prepare: Preparation: read your role, faction objective, and ability rules.
gameplay.flow.round: Action: complete tasks, gather information, use abilities, and track routes.
gameplay.flow.meeting: Meeting: discuss and vote after a report or bell; some meeting abilities may also be used.
gameplay.flow.end: Resolution: the match ends when a task, population, sabotage, or special-role condition succeeds.
gameplay.meeting.title: 02 · Meetings and Voting
gameplay.meeting.body: Report what you directly observed: time, location, and companions. Separate facts from guesses. Skipping can be reasonable without evidence, but consider urgent win conditions.
gameplay.tips.title: 03 · Useful Tips
gameplay.tips.one: Remember locations and approximate times; they are more useful than a name alone.
gameplay.tips.two: Do not reveal critical roles without need; some Ducks can guess roles during meetings.
gameplay.tips.three: Treat the current server resource pack and the text in this guide as the authoritative rules.
